Every dot on the line below is one survey — one quarter of banks answering the same question. Drag
the scrubber to walk through them; the dispatch underneath rewrites itself for whichever quarter you land on.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

sloos = pd.read_parquet(Path("../../analysis/outputs/sloos_dashboard.parquet"))
sloos["survey_date"] = pd.to_datetime(sloos["survey_date"]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
ojs_define(sloos_all=sloos.to_dict(orient="records"))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import { Plot } from "npm:@observablehq/plot"

rows = sloos_all.map(d => ({date: new Date(d.survey_date), loan_type: d.loan_type, value: +d.net_pct_tightening}))
LOAN_TYPES = ["C&I - Large", "C&I - Small", "Consumer - Credit Card", "Consumer - Auto"]
quarters = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(d => +d.date))).sort((a, b) => a - b).map(t => new Date(t))
byQuarter = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const q of quarters) m.set(+q, {});
  for (const r of rows) m.get(+r.date)[r.loan_type] = r.value;
  return m;
}
ci = quarters.map(q => ({date: q, value: byQuarter.get(+q)["C&I - Large"] ?? null}))

fmt = (v, s = false) => v == null ? "—" : `${s && v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${(+v).toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 1})}`
qLabel = d => `Q${Math.floor(d.getUTCMonth() / 3) + 1} ${d.getUTCFullYear()}`
isoDate = d => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
ord = n => { const s = ["th", "st", "nd", "rd"], v = n % 100; return n + (s[(v - 20) % 10] || s[v] || s[0]); }

narrate = i => {
  const q = ci[i], p = i > 0 ? ci[i - 1] : null;
  if (q.value == null) return "No C&I reading was published this quarter.";
  const dd = (p && p.value != null) ? q.value - p.value : null;
  const dir = q.value > 0 ? "tightening" : q.value < 0 ? "easing" : "holding steady on";
  const move = dd == null ? ""
    : dd > 0 ? `, up ${dd.toFixed(1)} points from the prior quarter`
    : dd < 0 ? `, down ${Math.abs(dd).toFixed(1)} points from the prior quarter`
    : `, unchanged from the prior quarter`;
  const watch = q.value >= 40 ? "past the +40% line that has historically preceded recessions"
    : q.value >= 20 ? "above the +20% line that has historically been worth watching"
    : "still short of the +20% watch line";
  let s = 0; for (let j = i; j >= 0; j--) { if (ci[j].value > 0) s++; else break; }
  const streak = (q.value > 0 && s > 1) ? ` It is the ${ord(s)} straight quarter of net tightening.` : "";
  return `Banks reported a net ${fmt(q.value, true)}% ${dir} in large-firm C&I standards${move} — ${watch}.${streak}`;
}

// Demo editor's notes — placeholders in Ben's voice slot; replace with real takes.
takes = ({
  "2020-04-01": "The COVID quarter. The window didn't tighten so much as slam — the sharpest move this series has ever recorded. Mostly a reminder that sentiment can travel 60 points in a single survey when everyone panics at once.",
  "2023-04-01": "The SVB aftershock shows up here as a real tightening impulse. It was real. It also faded faster than the regional-bank doom crowd wanted it to."
})
```

## The timeline

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="scrub-ends">
  <span>${qLabel(quarters[0])}</span>
  <span class="mid">◀ drag through time ▶</span>
  <span>${qLabel(quarters[quarters.length - 1])}</span>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof qi = html`<input type="range" class="scrubber" min="0" max="${quarters.length - 1}" step="1" value="${quarters.length - 1}">`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const step = d => {
    const el = viewof qi;
    el.value = Math.max(0, Math.min(quarters.length - 1, +el.value + d));
    el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  const mk = (label, d) => {
    const b = html`<button>${label}</button>`;
    b.onclick = () => step(d);
    return b;
  };
  return html`<div class="scrub-btns">${mk("◀ Prev quarter", -1)}${mk("Next quarter ▶", 1)}</div>`;
}
```

{
  const i = +qi;
  const sel = ci[i];
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 860, height: 300, marginLeft: 34, marginBottom: 26, marginTop: 18, marginRight: 14,
    x: {type: "utc", label: null, ticks: 6, tickFormat: "%Y"},
    y: {label: null, grid: true, tickFormat: d => `${d}%`},
    style: {fontFamily: "DM Mono, monospace", fontSize: "10px"},
    marks: [
      Plot.rect([{s: new Date("2020-02-01"), e: new Date("2020-05-01")}],
        {x1: "s", x2: "e", y1: -20, y2: 100, fill: "#1C1C1E", fillOpacity: 0.04}),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#9CA3AF", strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
      Plot.ruleY([20], {stroke: "#B45309", strokeDasharray: "2,4", strokeOpacity: 0.7}),
      Plot.text([{}], {x: quarters[0], y: 20, text: ["+20% watch"], textAnchor: "start", dx: 3, dy: -5, fill: "#B45309", fontSize: 10}),
      Plot.lineY(ci, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "#C8C3B8", strokeWidth: 1}),
      Plot.lineY(ci.slice(0, i + 1), {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "#4A6FA5", strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.ruleX([sel.date], {stroke: "#1C1C1E", strokeDasharray: "2,3", strokeOpacity: 0.45}),
      Plot.dot([sel], {x: "date", y: "value", r: 5, fill: "#4A6FA5", stroke: "#F7F6F2", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      Plot.text([sel], {x: "date", y: "value", text: d => fmt(d.value, true) + "%", dy: -13, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12, fill: "#1C1C1E"})
    ]
  });
}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const i = +qi;
  const q = quarters[i];
  const v = byQuarter.get(+q)["C&I - Large"];
  const tag = v == null ? null
    : v >= 20 ? {t: "watch line", c: "tag-watch"}
    : v > 0 ? {t: "net tightening", c: "tag-tight"}
    : {t: "net easing", c: "tag-ease"};
  const take = takes[isoDate(q)];

  return html`<div class="dispatch">
    <div class="dsp-date">Dispatch · ${qLabel(q)} · SLOOS release</div>
    <div class="dsp-head">
      <span class="dsp-num">${fmt(v, true)}<span class="u">%</span></span>
      ${tag ? html`<span class="dsp-tag ${tag.c}">${tag.t}</span>` : ""}
    </div>
    <p class="dsp-narr">${narrate(i)}</p>
    <div class="dsp-grid">
      ${LOAN_TYPES.map(lt => html`<div class="dsp-cell">
        <div class="lbl">${lt}</div>
        <div class="v">${fmt(byQuarter.get(+q)[lt], true)}${byQuarter.get(+q)[lt] == null ? "" : "%"}</div>
      </div>`)}
    </div>
    <div class="editor-note">
      <div class="en-label">Editor's note ${take ? html`<span class="en-sample">· sample</span>` : ""}</div>
      ${take
        ? html`<p class="en-text">${take}</p>`
        : html`<p class="en-empty">No editor's note for this dispatch yet — this is where the hand-written take goes.</p>`}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```
